metadata.title: Therapy-anchored Multi-omics Prioritization Score for giant cell arteritis
metadata.description: TMPS is a transparent, reproducible, rule-based integrative genomics framework for candidate-mechanism prioritization in giant cell arteritis. The package includes example input and output files, prespecified scoring parameters, scoring scripts, ablation and parameter-robustness analyses, benchmark ranking, and random-weight Monte Carlo robustness analysis.
